### Verify checksum on Windows

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\OfficeAI-Setup-x.y.z.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```

## Install
1. Close all Office applications.
2. Run the signed installer.
3. Reopen Office.
4. Confirm the **Office AI** ribbon entry is visible.

Full guide: `docs/install.md`
